name: Aske Til Aske
source: The story takes place in a quiet little town, tucked away somewhere in the decaying corners of Europe. The protagonist’s childhood home burns to the ground. It’s not the end of the world; he can stay with friends, get new documents, and figure something out. But that house held all his dreams and meaning, all the memories of a happy childhood, and his late parents. Now, there's only ash and dust left in its place... and a strange girl with an otherworldly appearance, clearly confused by her surroundings, someone he definitely shouldn't ignore.
